activeExplicitRules.rule: When operator input is genuinely required, emit exactly one executable handoff and consume its receipt before emitting any downstream executable handoff.

incidents.failure: After reaching a real Termux runtime boundary, the assistant emitted multiple executable scripts/commands instead of one handoff and waiting for its receipt.
incidents.correction: One executable handoff at a time; consume the runtime receipt before producing another.
incidents.regression: A response at an operator-input boundary with more than one executable handoff, or a downstream executable command emitted before receipt consumption, must fail Fortress V2 acceptance.
